d:
The Orgy of the Fallen Angels is an adult manga illustrated by Dirty Matsumoto. It was serialized in the magazine World Comics and was adapted into a VHS anime by Orange Video House in 1985.
Special thanks to netizen Hiiragi Kagami 柊鏡 for purchasing, scanning and producing the digital version of this manga.
n: [Manga] [Dirty Matsumoto] Orgy of Fallen Angels/datenshi tachi no ko kyoen
